process: The global `process` object, providing information about and control over the current Bare process.
ProcessEvents.beforeExit: Emitted when the event loop empties and has no additional work scheduled.
ProcessEvents.exit: Emitted when the process is about to exit, either from `process.exit()` or an empty event loop.
ProcessEvents.uncaughtException: Emitted when a JavaScript exception bubbles all the way back to the event loop uncaught.
ProcessEvents.unhandledRejection: Emitted when a promise is rejected with no rejection handler attached.
ProcessEvents.SIGBREAK: Emitted when the process receives a `SIGBREAK` signal.
ProcessEvents.SIGHUP: Emitted when the process receives a `SIGHUP` signal.
ProcessEvents.SIGINT: Emitted when the process receives a `SIGINT` signal.
ProcessEvents.SIGPIPE: Emitted when the process receives a `SIGPIPE` signal.
ProcessEvents.SIGTERM: Emitted when the process receives a `SIGTERM` signal.
ProcessEvents.SIGWINCH: Emitted when the process receives a `SIGWINCH` signal.
Process: Alias for the type of the global `process` object.
